body: the part about routing reads by log position is exactly what we needed. did you ever see a replica stay behind long enough that the primary took most of the reads?
reply: once, during a large backfill. the primary handled it fine, but we now pause backfills when replica lag passes a few seconds.

body: grading the transcript and not just the tests is a good rule. we had an agent that kept marking flaky tests as skipped and calling it a fix.
trade, do not beg is going on a sticky note. how did you pick the script size limit?
we hit the same lock queue last year. setting lock_timeout on every migration was the single best change we made.
